name: Confused Travolta
look: A blurry, low-resolution film still of John Travolta as Vincent Vega in a dark suit, holding his coat and glancing around a sparse, pale room, with a reel-to-reel tape deck on a shelf at left and white slipcovered chairs at right.
use: Shows someone lost and searching for something that is not there. Often animated and pasted into another scene, captioned with what the confused person expected to find, like a missing feature, a friend who left or a promised party.
slots: caption: what he is looking for or confused about
examples: Me looking for the easy part of the easy recipe
Me walking into the kitchen and forgetting why I came in
describe: travolta in a suit looking around a room puzzled
pulp fiction guy in a suit looking for something
man holding his coat glancing left and right
lost guy searching an empty room gif
origin: John Travolta as Vincent Vega looking around Mia Wallace's house in Quentin Tarantino's Pulp Fiction (1994).
